text:
### 
Enrolling Children

What is the enrolment procedure for children below the age of 5 years (Resident Indian/NRI)?
Whether UIDAI has defined a process to be followed for HOF enrolments?
For child age-group (0-18 yrs) Normally up to 30 days from the date of enrolment. and For Adults age 18+, normally up to 180 days from the date of enrolment. For enrolment/update request a verification may be conducted through concerned Authorities(State), before Aadhaar generation. With 90% service standards. If - 1. Quality of enrolment data meets prescribed standards laid down by UIDAI 2. The enrolment packet passes all the validations done in CIDR 3. No Demographic/Biometric duplicate is found 4. No unforeseen technical issues
